$comment: Machine-readable facts for one provider. Prose lives in ../token-storage.md; this file is the single source of truth for the facts themselves. Intended to move to shambles/providers/ once a loader exists. JSON, not TOML/YAML, so no dependency beyond stdlib json.

surfaces_excluded.Claude Desktop: separate store: safeStorage-encrypted config.json + cookie jar. Its embedded claude-code receives CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN by env and never reads this store.

config_dir_hash.present_when: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set AND CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR is not the empty string

darwin.notes: Item is created with no -T/-A ACL, so any process running as the user can read it without a prompt. Payload is written hex-encoded via -X.

win32.account_note: always this literal on Windows, unlike macOS/Linux

chunked.note: reader MUST reassemble; there is no single entry

config_dir_env.name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
config_dir_env.docs_are_wrong: official docs claim macOS credentials carry over when this is set; they do not

credential.container_note: read-modify-write; other top-level keys must be preserved

sibling_keys.mcpOAuth: per-MCP-server OAuth tokens, keyed '<serverId>|<hash>'. Account-scoped: these travel with a switch.

liveness.optional_note: absent from credentials written by the VS Code extension bundle; treat a missing value as unknown, not as expired

identity.plan_pointer_warning: do NOT use claudeAiOauth.subscriptionType — it read 'team' for a Max 5x account
identity.probe_note: emits JSON on stdout; read-only; preferred over parsing the file

companion_writes.note: keys absent from the incoming profile are deleted, not left holding the previous account's identity

login.note: run in a terminal, not inside VS Code — the extension may hold a handle on the profile
